note: Accessibility shortcut menu -- renders: Skip to main content, Keyboard shortcuts, Search, Cart, Home, Your orders, Show shortcuts

Main navigation bar -- renders: Amazon logo, Search, All, Today's Deals, Customer Service, Help, Cart, Orders, Account, and fixed category links; excludes user-specific location, account name, and order/cart counts
Secondary navigation bar -- renders: fixed category links like Today's Deals, Customer Service, Help, etc.
Out of stock buybox message -- renders: fixed 'Currently unavailable' text and 'Add to List' button
Product overview expander toggle -- renders: 'See more' or 'See less' button
About this item section header and toggle -- renders: 'About this item' heading and 'See more' button; excludes the seller-provided feature bullet list
Bottom of page sub-navigation tabs -- renders: fixed tab labels like 'About this item', 'Product information', 'Customer reviews'
Product details table row headers -- renders: fixed attribute labels like 'Brand', 'Model Name', 'Item Weight', 'ASIN'
What's in the box list -- renders: fixed list of included components defined by the operator for this product
Customer ratings histogram -- renders: fixed star rating labels (5 star, 4 star, etc.) and 'Customer reviews' heading
Review filter tabs -- renders: fixed filter labels like 'All reviewers', 'Verified purchase', '5 star', '4 star', etc.
Review media carousel heading -- renders: 'Photos from customers' or similar fixed label
Link to all reviews -- renders: 'See more reviews' or similar fixed call to action
Site footer -- renders: fixed navigation links, legal text, and 'Back to top' button
